Lists the LikeC4 projects available in the workspace.

involved_tools.name: read-project-summary
involved_tools.description:
Summarize a LikeC4 project: configuration, specification (element, relationship, and deployment kinds, tags, and metadata keys), and all elements, deployment entities, and views with their IDs, kinds, titles, and tags.

Usage rules:
- Use this to orient yourself in a project before reading individual elements or views.
- project defaults to "default".

project.description: Project id (optional, will use "default" if not specified)

involved_tools.name: search-element
involved_tools.description:
Search elements and deployment nodes across all projects by ID, title, kind, shape, tag, or metadata key. Returns the total match count and the first 20 results; use returned IDs with read tools.

Usage rules:
- Provide a case-insensitive search string of at least 2 characters.
- Use kind:<value> or shape:<value> to match a kind or shape exactly; use meta:<key> to find elements with a metadata key; use #<value> to find tags containing a value.
- Any other search string is matched against element IDs (FQNs) or titles.

search.description: Case-insensitive. "kind:<value>" or "shape:<value>" matches a kind or shape exactly, "meta:<key>" elements with that metadata key, "#<value>" tags containing the value; anything else matches id (FQN) or title.

- If the user omits the source or target timezone, use America/New_York for that timezone.
